name: Eureka Lithium Corp.
summary: Eureka Lithium Corp. is an emerging mining company dedicated to identifying, exploring, and developing mineral resources throughout Canada. The firm possesses an exclusive right to acquire a 75% ownership share in the North McKinney property, which consists of five mining claims covering 1,289 hectares situated on the southeastern face of Mt. Baldy in southern British Columbia. Initially incorporated in 2021 as Scout Minerals Corp., the company adopted its current name, Eureka Lithium Corp., in June 2023. Its operational base is in Vancouver, Canada.
